manifest.reason: Template fields must be replaced with reviewed physical evidence before validator pass is possible.

collection_plan.physical_meaning: Prove the zero-gas route and dryer are dry enough before any formal CO2 dry/zero point.
collection_plan.required_evidence: Dewpoint trace after route/dryer check with stable tail.
collection_plan.pass_condition: status=pass; dewpoint_c <= -28 C; tail_span_c <= 0.5 C; tail_slope_abs_c_per_s <= 0.01; route_or_dryer_checked=true.
collection_plan.recommended_artifacts: dewpoint_trace.csv plus route/dryer check note or trace.
collection_plan.forbidden_actions: Do not write SN/device_code/SENCO, do not connect PostgreSQL, do not start CO2/H2O queue.

collection_plan.physical_meaning: Prove PACE vent communication recovered after previous NO_RESPONSE failures.
collection_plan.required_evidence: PACE vent ON/OFF roundtrip trace with no NO_RESPONSE.
collection_plan.forbidden_actions: Do not write SN/device_code/SENCO, do not connect PostgreSQL, do not start CO2/H2O queue.

collection_plan.physical_meaning: Prove COM22 pressure gauge readback uses mature INL absolute pressure and is responsive.
collection_plan.required_evidence: Pressure gauge readback trace using INL absolute-pressure source.
collection_plan.forbidden_actions: Do not write SN/device_code/SENCO, do not connect PostgreSQL, do not start CO2/H2O queue.

collection_plan.physical_meaning: Prevent another segmented/direct/retry run from being treated as the next formal continuous run.
collection_plan.required_evidence: Reviewed plan that names the mature 0613/0620/0621 CO2/H2O queue entrypoints.
collection_plan.pass_condition: fresh_canonical_queue=true; baseline includes 0613/0620/0621; forbidden_surfaces_absent=true; canonical queue entrypoints named.
collection_plan.recommended_artifacts: fresh run plan JSON or reviewed operator note.
collection_plan.forbidden_actions: Do not reference _handoff, 0624, diagnostic, worker, retry, or root migration surfaces.

collection_plan.physical_meaning: Keep old segmented/direct/retry evidence out of fitting unless explicitly superseded.
collection_plan.required_evidence: Accepted manifest path and supersedence review id, if segmented evidence will be used.
collection_plan.pass_condition: status=pass; accepted_manifest_path is non-empty; supersedence_review_id is non-empty.
collection_plan.forbidden_actions: Do not make segmented evidence fit-eligible without accepted-manifest review.

accepted_manifest_review.note: Required only before segmented/direct/retry evidence is made fit-eligible.

next_run_policy.note: Open the next continuous run from mature queue entrypoints only, not _handoff, 0624, worker, diagnostic, retry, or root migration surfaces.
